items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Paul Barber had the right idea with those five drummers, with that field band. You ain't no lie. Sure. [INTERVIEWEE] That was a risk. Sure, that's what gave you a break.

ctx.x: I never saw so much of St. Charles Avenue. Looked like I walked around the Belt before we hit Canal Street. Jesus, God. And when you get down to St. Charles, just like I told you before, both them bands is working. Mm-hmm. And I understood Anderson and Broussard. What? Say, now when we get there in front of all them people, the reviewing stand is just packed. Rex is reviewing stands all of them. Say, keep both them bands going. And we did that all the way down to St. Charles Canal and then turned Canal and kept…
Paul Barber had the right idea with those five drummers, with that field band. You ain't no lie. Sure.
That was a risk. Sure, that's what gave you a break.
